serverInfo.name: paychex-europe-payroll-mcp
serverInfo.title: Paychex Europe Payroll MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Paychex Europe Payroll, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the employees of our German company whose names start with Schmidt."; "What was the gross salary of employee 4711 in June 2026?"; "Which absences are recorded for this employee this year?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Paychex Europe Payroll data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run paychex_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run paychex_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run paychex_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. paychex_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: paychex_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies this API key may read, one page at a time. Read only. GET /companies/.

limit.description: Records per page, 1 to 100 (bound set by this server).

offset.description: Records to skip, for paging. Use the offset of the next page.

tools.name: paychex_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get one company with its legal and address data. Read only. GET /companies/{company_uid}/.

tools.name: paychex_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the employees of a company, one page at a time, with an optional name search. Returns personal data. Read only. GET /companies/{company_uid}/employees/.

search.description: Search text, for example a name or personal number.

valid_at.description: Month in YYYY-MM form, for example 2026-06. Omit for the current data.

limit.description: Records per page, 1 to 100 (bound set by this server).

offset.description: Records to skip, for paging. Use the offset of the next page.

tools.name: paychex_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: Get one employee: name, birth data, contact and social insurance data. Returns personal data. Read only. GET /companies/{company_uid}/employees/{employee_uid}/.

valid_at.description: Month in YYYY-MM form, for example 2026-06. Omit for the current data.

tools.name: paychex_get_employee_contract
tools.title: Get employee contract
tools.description: Get the contract of an employee for one month: start and end dates, employment type, occupation. Read only. GET /companies/{company_uid}/employees/{employee_uid}/contract/?valid_at=YYYY-MM.

valid_at.description: Month in YYYY-MM form, for example 2026-06.

tools.name: paychex_get_employee_salary
tools.title: Get employee salary
tools.description: Get the salary of an employee for one month: salary type, gross salary, hourly rate. Returns pay data. Read only. GET /companies/{company_uid}/employees/{employee_uid}/salary/?valid_at=YYYY-MM.

valid_at.description: Month in YYYY-MM form, for example 2026-06.

tools.name: paychex_list_employee_salary_components
tools.title: List employee salary components
tools.description: List the salary components (pay items) of an employee. Returns pay data. Read only. GET /companies/{company_uid}/employees/{employee_uid}/salary-components/.

tools.name: paychex_list_employee_absences
tools.title: List employee absences
tools.description: List the absences of an employee (leave, sickness, maternity), one page at a time. Read only. GET /companies/{company_uid}/employees/{employee_uid}/absence/.

limit.description: Records per page, 1 to 100 (bound set by this server).

offset.description: Records to skip, for paging. Use the offset of the next page.
